|ingredients = {{Name|Wheat Flour|1}}{{Name|Tomato|1}}{{Name|Cheese|1}} |sellprice = 300 |edibility = 60 }} '''Pizza''' is a [[Cooking|cooked dish]]. It is prepared using either the kitchen inside an upgraded [[farmhouse]] or a [[Cookout Kit]]. Pizza is also available for purchase daily at [[The Stardrop Saloon]] for {{Price|600}} and may randomly appear in [[Krobus]]' shop on [[Days of the Week#Saturday|Saturdays]]. [[Shane]] sells Pizza in his [[Desert Festival#Villager Shops|shop]] at the [[Desert Festival]] for {{Price|5|Calico}} [[Calico Egg]]s. One Pizza may be received from opening a [[Mystery Box]]. The [[Statue Of Endless Fortune]] produces one Pizza per year on [[Shane]]'s birthday, [[Spring|Spring 20]]. ==Gifting== {{GiftsByItem |like=Robin,Demetrius,Maru,Sebastian,Linus,Pierre,Caroline,Abigail,Alex,George,Evelyn,Lewis,Clint,Penny,Pam,Emily,Haley,Jas,Vincent,Jodi,Kent,Marnie,Gus,Dwarf,Wizard,Sandy |love=Sam,Shane |hate=Leah |dislike=Elliott,Harvey,Willy,Krobus,Leo }} ==Bundles== Pizza is not used in any [[bundles]]. ==Tailoring== Pizza is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the {{Name|Party Hat (red)|class=inline}}. It can also be used as a red dye in the dye pots, located in [[Haley]]'s and [[Emily]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]]. ==Quests== One Pizza may be requested by [[Blobfish]] in a [[Fish Pond#Quests|Fish Pond quest]] to increase the capacity of the pond from 3 to 5. ==History== {{History|1.4|Recipe price reduced from {{Price|750}} to {{Price|150}}. [[Harvey]] now dislikes it as a gift. Can now be used in [[Tailoring]].
